name: westwood_online_upgrade_dialog_enable_query_controls
description: WestwoodOnlineUpgradeDialog::EnableQueryControls forwards the requested enabled state to the WOL query-related controls and connect button.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x43d6b0 validates calls to CWnd::EnableWindow for controls at offsets 0x360, 0x1e0, 0x1a0, 0x160, 0x0e0, 0x220, and 0x260 with the same enable argument, then callee cleanup for the stack argument.
Native smoke westwood_online_upgrade_dialog_enable_controls_smoke patches CWnd::EnableWindow and verifies the exact control order and enable value for EnableQueryControls.
